detailed_description:
The video follows a modern, social-first product photography style with tactile, editorial energy. The lighting is natural and even, characteristic of late afternoon, with slight warmth in the highlights and lifted shadows creating an airy atmosphere. The color palette consists of crisp whites, warm neutrals, and a vibrant pop of coral from the product.

[Shot 1] The shot begins with the frame from <Picture 1>, a point-of-view (POV) from behind <Subject 2> holding a professional camera. On the camera's LCD screen, <Subject 1> is framed sitting on a downtown rooftop with a soft-focus city skyline and elevated train tracks. <Subject 1> holds <Subject 3> to her lips, carefully gliding the coral pigment across her lower lip. She looks into the camera lens with a focused expression. The reflection on the camera screen is crisp.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera performs a brisk, gentle push-in toward <Subject 1>. She finishes applying the lipstick and breaks into a confident, subtle grin, checking the result in the camera screen's reflection. The texture of <Subject 3> is visible as perfectly matte. The rooftop background remains a creamy bokeh of urban architecture, keeping the focus entirely on her face and the product's finish.

overall_soundscape:
The soft, tactile click of the lipstick cap being pressed into place. Distant ambient city hum of a passing train and the faint rustle of wind.
